headline: Hedge-driven loss overshadows strong operating growth
summary_short: Equitable Holdings reported a GAAP net loss of $453M (-$1.68 per diluted share) in Q2 2026, driven by non-cash derivative and market-risk-benefit swings on its variable-annuity hedge book, even as Non-GAAP operating EPS grew to $1.70 and the Company returned $449M to shareholders.
summary_long: GAAP net loss widened to $453M (-$1.68/share) from -$349M y/y, driven by non-cash derivative losses ($2,055M) and market risk benefit remeasurement on the variable-annuity book, not weaker underlying earnings. Non-GAAP operating earnings, which exclude that hedge volatility, rose to $488M ($1.70/share; $1.75 ex notable items) on higher Retirement fee revenue and AB base fees. AUM/A hit a record $1.2 trillion. The Company returned $449M to shareholders ($83M dividends, $366M buybacks) and reiterated its 60-70% FY2026 payout-ratio and $1.8B cash-generation targets. Equity attributable to Holdings fell to -$785M on AOCI; long-term debt held flat near $3.84B. No new numeric guidance issued; the Corebridge merger stays on track to close by year-end 2026.

drivers.explanation: The release attributes the net loss mainly to derivative and MRB fair-value swings from variable-annuity hedging, not core profitability; Non-GAAP operating earnings, which exclude that volatility, rose y/y on higher fee revenue.

Total revenues fell to $1,658M from $2,362M y/y and $4,230M q/q, driven mainly by a swing in net derivative losses to $(2,055)M from $(1,374)M y/y -- a hedge/MRB-accounting effect, not a business slowdown.

The Company's own reconciliation table isolates $1,522M of post-tax variable-annuity-related, non-operating adjustments this quarter versus $934M y/y, explaining the swing from operating profit to a reported net loss.
Pretax loss widened as net derivative losses and MRB remeasurement outpaced net investment income and fee revenue, per the release's own Non-GAAP reconciliation of hedge-related adjustments.
Tracks the net income swing to a loss plus a $13M preferred dividend, on a roughly flat 278.3M weighted average share count.
Same net income swing and preferred dividend as basic EPS; the loss is anti-dilutive so diluted and basic share counts are identical this quarter.
not explained in the release; debt was roughly flat q/q at $3,839M vs $3,837M but down from $4,332M a year earlier

Total equity attributable to Holdings fell mainly on a larger AOCI deduction (-$6,465M); book value per common share including AOCI was $(6.79), consistent with the release's own balance-sheet statistics.
Weighted share count fell y/y and q/q as the Company repurchased $366M of stock in the quarter, consistent with its disclosed capital-return program.
